OPERS is hiring a Full Stack Developer 1 to design, build, maintain, enhance, and test applications supporting internal processes and member services. The role collaborates with cross-functional teams to develop solutions that meet members’ needs and advance OPERS’s technology stack.
Government Administration
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
In this role, you will be a member of a team responsible for designing, building, maintaining, enhancing, and testing batch/messaging/web applications that drive our internal processes and help service our members, utilizing a variety of technology
You will work closely with our cross-functional teams to design and implement innovative solutions that meet our members' needs and drive our technology stack forward
Qualification
Automated Unit Testing
HTML5
Object-Oriented Programming
REST API Design and Development
Relational Databases
Java
Required
A passion for delivering high quality work
A strong understanding of Automated Unit Testing, HTML5, OO Programming Design, REST APT Design & Development, and Relational databases
A Bachelor's degree in related field OR a Bachelor's degree in any field along with Java-specific training (Candidates without a Bachelor's degree may be considered if they have an additional 4 years of relevant experience)
Benefits
Professional growth through development opportunities and continuing education
Pension plan plus 457(b) retirement account with company match opportunity
Onsite fitness center, cafeteria, and free onsite, covered parking garage
Generous time off and sick leave policy as well as 12 paid holidays each year
Hybrid work environment that includes the ability to work remotely up to 3 days per week; must be able to live within commuting distance of Columbus, OH
Access to financial and personal wellness tools and resources
